promise_gap: Google Ads Transparency: 6 live ads under advertiser AR10713925876992442369, verified as ZAHEERUDDIN JAVEED MOHAMMED.

The ads land on a homepage reporting 128 errors, where every trust counter reads zero and the click-to-call link has a space inside its href so the number cannot be dialled. The page pays for six ads' worth of clicks and then fails the two things a buyer does first.
The homepage presents 'Years of experience 0+', 'Installations 0+', 'Happy Customers 0%' and 'Customer Support 0/7' next to a '1,248 reviews' Google badge.

The four counters and the review badge contradict each other on the same screen, and the checker reports 100 elements sitting where they are not allowed - 55

inside , 22

inside , 15

inside and 7
    inside - which is what breaks the counters' markup.

The site lists off-grid and on-grid SPV plants, hybrid plants, solar-powered micro and mini grids, street lighting, fencing, water heating and water pumping, and is empanelled with TGREDCO under registration TSRE180047.

The TGREDCO register independently confirms Milestone Solarcom Pvt Ltd and that registration number, so the capability claim is substantiated by a government source. The page itself publishes no price, no system size and no project photograph in this pass, so a prospect cannot size the offer.
The site's copy carries 'top solar comapy in hyderabad', 'This Shceme' and 'Sustanability Focused'.
Three spelling errors in the primary conversion copy, on a page whose meta description opens 'Looking for best solar company in Hyderabad?' - the exact phrase six live ads are buying.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
